notes.title: A new English version in the work
notes.notes:
As we saw with the community review of the demos, one of the main points was the mistranslation of the English version (translated from French).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42198661/12c32ab0c288903a7b57a8d4a4793d2b78988b9b.png

Knowing this, it’s imperative for us to fix it before the next release, and we are now actively working on it! Get ready for a revamped version soon!
